name: Efficient
description: Appropriated and renamed by the assassin droid SCr-114, the Efficient was a Subla Ransom Medium Cargo Hauler modified to suit an all-droid crew. Escape pods, living quarters, life support system, entertainment consoles, and food processors were all stripped away to make place for an all-ship droid maintenance, repair, and upgrading facility.

data.name: Efficient
data.armament: 6 blaster cannons, proton torpedo launcher, ion cannon
